name: jobbot
description: AI job-skill analyzer: LLM skill extraction + ESCO normalization, prioritized resume-gap reports, and a LangGraph agent that suggests honest resume bullets. FastAPI + React, live demo.

paragraphs: Live demo: jobbot-jet.vercel.app (backend runs on a free tier and may take 30s to wake on first request)
Paste a job description (and optionally upload your resume as a PDF) and JobBot:

The project started as a graduate NLP course project (fine-tuned DistilBERT NER → ESCO normalization, in notebooks) and was re-architected into a deployed product with the LLM extractor benchmarked head-to-head against the fine-tuned model on human-annotated gold data. The original write-up is preserved below.
features: Extracts skills from the raw text with an LLM (Groq, openai/gpt-oss-120b, structured JSON output; model id overridable via GROQMODEL) and highlights them inline.

Normalizes each skill to the ESCO taxonomy (13.9k skills, 99k surface variants indexed with BM25 + exact/substring matching) and groups them into a readable skill profile (Languages, Frameworks, Cloud/DevOps, …).

Computes a prioritized resume-gap report — matches JD skills against your resume by ESCO id or word-boundary surface form, and splits gaps into critical (required, missing) vs minor (nice-to-have) with a coverage score.

Suggests honest resume bullets with a LangGraph agent: each gap is classified as transferable (your resume shows adjacent evidence → reframe it, with the grounding quote) or genuine (no evidence → a "how to build it"…
